description: Lane preset 'critical': cluster- or estate-wide blast radius where a manual deploy step still follows the merge (ArgoCD manual sync, an Ansible or Terraform run). Soak patch 7d / minor 14d / major 21d; patch, digest and pin automerge after the soak because the merge itself deploys nothing; minor and major are manual merges. GHCR and Quay images publish no release date and cannot be soaked: their MR opens at once and waits for a manual merge. Critical dependencies whose merge deploys use lane-manual instead. Extend with `local>example-org/renovate:lane-critical(<file glob>)`; the argument is one matchFileNames glob, braces allowed.
